data.narrative:
Sagar Defence Engineering is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $25.4M to date. Valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies spanning public equities (2 names: DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private venture-backed firms (8 names including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing), all operating in the Defense & Security sector at similar or proximate stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy valuation base, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $51M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 most directly comparable same-sector, same-stage private companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity within the defense tech segment.

Triangulation of both methods supports a valuation range of $43M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $225M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; peer-median dominates the upper range. Key uncertainties include the relevance of the $4.0B outlier (Stark Defence) to Sagar's profile, the representativeness of a 3-company peer set, and comparative positioning on technology maturity and customer traction within the defense vertical.
